Many, many moons ago, there was a cat who lived on these mountains named Kharis.
The tribes were different then. We had different names, different customs.
But, she wanted to unite us all.
Under her rule, of course.
When no one would follow her, she became desperate and turned to dark magic.
She began using this magic to trick others into loving and following her.
That is, until a little tom named Fox uncovered what she was doing.
When he told the tribes, they were furious.
They ran to her secret hideout beneath dark rock ready to slaughter her for her crimes, but she was gone.
They looked everywhere, but couldn't find her.
They never saw her again.
Some said that little Fox had made everything up, and because of this he was scorned for much of his life.
But, others say it would have been impossible for him to fake, what with all the symbols drawn on the floor,
The blood pooled and congealing in her lair, and the strange poultices mixed together.
